title: S2 · The Night Off
note: 'The first evening that belongs to them... staying in, over the wire, or the late crew.' Three genuinely different places (a locked hangar, the city at night, a working night shift) in one long scene -- no shared bed, same reasoning as The Long Afternoon. Relaxed pool for the base state; if a player goes over the wire, reach for a city-night bed by hand from the desk rather than treating this file as covering that path.
